title: Eval Generator I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 127. The model's own job is narrow -- given a function's real production failures (rejected_all/expired_unresolved decisions from GET /decision-history, never a fabricated example), write each into the Fn 112 harness's regression-case shape. Assembling the OptionCard (contracts/option-card.schema.json) -- the A/full-set, B/20-case-sample, C/hold options, letting dispatch.py's own recommendation logic (prompt.md's 'recommend B for the first suite') pick the default -- is orchestrator code (services/orchestrator/orchestrator/dispatch.py's eval_generator_handler calling services/options_inbox/cards.py's build_card), not this model's job. Source 1 (production failures) only in this PR -- see dispatch.py's own module-section docstring for why decision-history pairs / rubric expansion / adversarial cases (prompt.md's sources 2-4) are a documented follow-up.

production_failures.description: Real rejected_all/expired_unresolved decisions for this function in the trailing window -- every case the model writes must trace to one of these, never an invented failure.

cases.description: One regression case per production failure given -- prompt.md task step 1.

source_card_id.description: The card_id this case traces to -- must be one of the production_failures given, never invented.

expected_verdict.description: What the harness should assert -- typically the same rejection_code the real decision recorded.

rationale.description: Two sentences on what pattern this batch of failures reveals, per prompt.md's own card-evidence convention.
